Inspector Suspended for Alleged Collusion with Escaped Accused

Inspector Vineet Dubey has been suspended by Bastar IG for alleged collusion with Shoaib Dhebar, an accused who escaped in Raipur. Two constables have also been suspended in connection with the incident.
